2) For AP routing, please complete this small sheet so we capture remit vs billing addresses and the invoice email alias: payment-routing-sheet.xlsx (I can also accept a completed table inline).
3) For ACH, we use a standard ACH mandate template. I'll send a DocuSign link you can sign; if you need to use your own vendor bank form please attach it and note any PO/contract requirements.

Kimberly (Finance): can you confirm whether we should set default terms to Net30 for this supplier or request Net45 given the enterprise discounts Halcyon referenced?
Karthik (Vendor Ops): once Daniel confirms the entity type and we receive the routing sheet, can you run the identity proof check and create the vendor code (vendor master) with the remittance mapping to 'invoices@halcyonparts.com'?

I'll wait for the payment sheet and the ACH mandate. If it's easier, Daniel, you can reply with the small table filled out in your next email.

Best,
